name: Clypmint: AI Video Editor
original_description: Turn your footage or approved script into a video in ChatGPT. Cut pauses, add captions, make podcast clips, create faceless videos and reuse editing styles. Review playable results, change a selected clip, fix caption spellings and continue the same project in Clypmint Studio. A connected Clypmint account is required. Existing account rights and usage limits apply. Upload links are provided when the host cannot transfer a file.
summary_ja: 映像や台本から動画を作り、字幕やクリップの編集を支援する。
limitations_ja: Clypmintアカウントの接続が必要。既存の権限と利用上限が適用される。
